notes.title: SideTracked! Demo Update 1.0
notes.content:
An update to the demo has been pushed. In addition to a myriad of small bug fixes, the following notable fixes have been introduced:
[list]
[*] Fixed audio being super loud at game start.
[*] Fixed damage not being dealt to enemies
[*] Fixed edge cases where enemies would not spawn
[*] Fixed players falling through ground at spawn 
[*] Fixed grass and shrubbery not spawning
[/list]

The update will be pushed within a few minutes.

Sincerely,

AquaDark
Group Eight
